release.title: designer slice
release.summary: Weapons editor for ranged and melee weapons; vanilla output, optional Combat Extended patches

scope.text: Weapons editor: ranged and melee, math, quiz, fit meter
Optional CE patch generator: new, convert, update, lint
JSON document store for drafts and calibration caches
CLI commands for all of it with JSON output

exit.text: Fictional ranged and melee weapon: plan and files, byte equal
CE off writes no CE file; on writes gated patch files
Convert and update modes give a patch only reviewable diff
Drafts survive a restart; a corrupt document is quarantined
CLI runs on a fixture install; real install tests only read
No game or CE value table in the repository (licence check)
fmt, clippy and tests clean in every crate
Added check: a generated mod loads in RimWorld itself

extras.text: Tauri desktop shell with live reload
Temporary dark UI: Setup, Mod, Weapons, Patches
Weapon wizard: every number from a category
Texture and sound import; layout fixes with undo
CE bows, weapon platforms and custom ammunition
Mod page: create a mod, edit About and LoadFolders
Test in game: link a mod into RimWorld's Mods folder
